# What Is Metaphysics?

*[Martin Heidegger](../philosophers/heidegger.md) · 1929 · *Was ist Metaphysik?**

The inaugural lecture given at Freiburg in 1929, in which [Heidegger](../philosophers/heidegger.md) questions the nothing that science excludes from its field: anxiety reveals it and, with it, beings as a whole. He added a postscript (1943) and an introduction (1949).
